$sources: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 88 (the seismic storey shear Qi = Ci ΣWi, Ci = Z Rt Ai C0)
MOC Notification No. 1793 of 1980: Art. 1 Z, Art. 2 Rt and the period T, Art. 3 Ai, Art. 4 the soil types
BSL Enforcement Order Art. 82-2 (storey drift 1/200), Art. 82-6 (Rs >= 0.6, Re <= 0.15)
source: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 88 and MOC Notification 1793

generatorSystems.$comment: SAEngine practice: the law has no ductility classes of systems (the member ranks give Ds), one system of each kind

stability.clause: the law has no P-delta rule (SAEngine practice for θ)

S1.description: Soil type 1: rock, hard sandy gravel and the like (Tertiary or older), or a site whose period is equally short (Tc = 0.4 s)

S2.description: Soil type 2: neither type 1 nor type 3 (Tc = 0.6 s)

S3.description: Soil type 3: alluvium with humus or mud and the like, or reclaimed land, of the depth of N1793 Art. 2, or a site whose period is equally long (Tc = 0.8 s)

rcDualSpecial.name: RC frame and shear walls (both resisting)

allowableDriftLabel: All buildings (BSL Enforcement Order Art. 82-2: 1/200; 1/120 where the finishes and the like are shown not to be damaged)

sources.designSpectrum: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 88(1): Ci = Z Rt Ai C0; MOC Notification 1793 Art. 2: Rt = 1 (T < Tc), 1 - 0.2 (T/Tc - 1)² (Tc <= T < 2 Tc), 1.6 Tc / T (2 Tc <= T); Art. 3: Ai = 1 + (1/√αi - αi) 2T / (1 + 3T); Art. 88(2): C0 at least 0.2 (0.3 on very soft ground designated by the authority for wooden buildings: not covered); Art. 88(3): C0 at least 1.0 for the required horizontal capacity. The response spectrum of a modal analysis is Z C0 Rt(T) (SAEngine practice).
sources.siteClasses: MOC Notification 1793 Art. 2 table: the soil types 1-3 and Tc = 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 s (ids S1-S3)
sources.systems: The law has no R: R = 1 (C0 is the design level), Cd = 1 (the drift of the primary design is the elastic one under the C0 = 0.2 forces); Ω0 = 2.0 SAEngine practice; the systems' Ds in horizontalCapacity
sources.periodCoefficients: MOC Notification 1793 Art. 2: T = h (0.02 + 0.01 α), α the share of the height of steel storeys: 0.02 h concrete (α = 0), 0.03 h steel (α = 1); mixed structures take the family of their system (SAEngine practice)
sources.designCategories: The law has no seismic design categories: SAEngine's letters C (Z 0.7, 0.8) and D (Z 0.9, 1.0) for the parent's modules, the detailing ordinary (the member ranks give Ds)
sources.allowableDrift: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 82-2: the storey drift angle under the primary seismic force at most 1/200 (1/120 where the finishes and the like are shown not to be damaged: raise it under Code Values)
sources.lateralForce: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 88(1) and N1793 Art. 3: the storey shear Qi = Ci ΣWi with Ai, the level forces the differences of the storey shears
sources.liveShare: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 85(1) column (iii): the seismic weight takes each use's value for the seismic force (liveWeight byUse); the uses without one 50 % (SAEngine practice)
sources.accidentalEccentricity: The law has no accidental eccentricity (Re, Fe instead): 0.05 only where the project asks for the eccentric cases (SAEngine practice)
sources.torsionAmplificationMax: No amplification of the accidental torsion: 1.0
sources.pgaFactor: SAEngine's mapping of Z to the peak ground acceleration for the checks that ask for it (0.4 Z, not the law's)
sources.verticalFactor: The law has no vertical seismic component in the combinations: 0
sources.periodUpperFactor: N1793 Art. 2 allows a period from a special investigation (Rt at least 3/4 of the formula's): not applied, the formula's T is used
sources.minimumScale: The law has no scaling of a modal analysis to the static shear: 1.0 (SAEngine practice)
sources.stability: The law has no P-delta rule: θ = P dr / (V h), ignored below 0.10 (SAEngine practice)
